_comment: Pelican Egg: WireGuard + Nginx + PHP-FPM. Web server with a VPN tunnel for hosting Minecraft maps.
name: WireGuard + Nginx + PHP-FPM
author: pelmentor@github.com
description: Nginx + PHP-FPM web server with a WireGuard VPN client. Designed for hosting interactive Minecraft maps (BlueMap, Dynmap, Squaremap) with data delivered over a WG tunnel.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash # ============================================================================= # Installation script — runs on server creation/reinstallation. # Container: ubuntu:22.04 (separate from the runtime container!). # Writes to /mnt/server/ — mounted as /home/container/ at runtime. # # Ref: pelican-eggs — standard pattern: # apt install deps → mkdir → download/copy defaults # ============================================================================= set -e echo "============================================" echo " WG + Nginx + PHP-FPM — Installation" echo "============================================" apt-get update apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates # Directory structure mkdir -p /mnt/server/webroot mkdir -p /mnt/server/wg mkdir -p /mnt/server/nginx mkdir -p /mnt/server/php mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp # Default page (do not overwrite if already present — the user may have uploaded their own files) if [ ! -f /mnt/server/webroot/index.html ]; then cat > /mnt/server/webroot/index.html <<'HTMLEOF' Map Server

Map server is running!

Upload your map files to the webroot/ directory.

Powered by WG + Nginx + PHP-FPM egg for Pelican Panel

HTMLEOF fi echo "" echo "Installation complete!" echo "Start the server, then upload map files to webroot/" echo "============================================"

variables.name: WireGuard Private Key
variables.description: WireGuard private key for this container. Generate with: wg genkey. Leave empty to disable WG.

variables.name: WireGuard Address
variables.description: Container IP address in the WG network (CIDR notation). Must match the MC server's WG configuration.

variables.name: WireGuard Listen Port
variables.description: WireGuard UDP port. Set this if the container accepts incoming WG connections. Add as a UDP allocation in Pelican.

variables.name: Peer Public Key
variables.description: Public key of the WG peer (MC server). Obtain from the server administrator.

variables.name: Peer Endpoint
variables.description: WG peer address — host:port. Leave empty if the peer connects to us.

variables.name: Peer Allowed IPs
variables.description: IPs routed through the WG tunnel. Typically the MC server's IP in the WG network.
